title: Super cute bath mat!
text: Super cute bath mat!. This is a really nice bath mat. Super thick and soft, it feels so good when I stop out of the shower. It also cleans easily (have washed it twice already and it comes out looking like new). It also matches my shower curtain and bath towels, so it's a perfect fit for my bath. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: EGYPHY Luxury Chenille Bathroom Rug 20 x 32 Extra Soft and Absorbent Bath Rug Non Slip Shaggy Bath Mat Plush Washable Carpet Mats for Tub Shower, Bathtub and Bath Room, Grey
features: Soft & Comfortable: Enjoy the comfort of standing on the clouds! Thick luxury chenille bath mat to fit and support your feet. This bath mat is made of 100% ultra-soft plush chenille each fiber about 1 inch, 6mm foam inside relieves pressure and fatigue on your feet, keeps toes warm on the cold floor.

Extra Absorbent: Bathroom rug soft coral velvet microfiber layer which maximum absorb moisture instantly from your shower feet and dry quickly. It is super thick and cushiony keep your feet warm and feeling cozy. Just enjoy the nature calling time.

Non-Slip Backing: The bathroom mat is the first thing you must touch after leaving the shower or bathtub. Bath shower floor mat is backed with PVC dots to ensures that the bath mat grips firmly to the floor for safety and prevent shifting and skidding. Thick chenille fabric helps save your floors from dripping water moisture is trapped in the rug’s deep pile, allowing the rug to dry quickly and cleanly.

Multipurpose: Luxury chenille rug can be widely used in various occasions, such as bathroom, bathtub side,kitchen, living room, meeting room, study room, hallway, bedroom, sliding room, laundry room balcony , front of the sink, indoor&outdoor etc. and any place in your home where you want support and relax on your toes!

Machine Wash & Dry: Machine washable for bathroom rugs separately in cold water. When needed, please dry at low temperature or hang dry. Also you can simply pick up and shake rug to freshen. GUARANTEE: If you are at all unsatisfied with your product, please contact us and we will be happy to provide you with your choice of a replacement or refund. We stand by our products and want our customers to love them as much as we do!
